Bash(python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
json.load\(open\('.qoder/settings.json'\)\)
print\('settings.json: valid JSON'\)
try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    print\('PyYAML not installed; skipping frontmatter parse'\)
    sys.exit\(0\)
for p in sorted\(pathlib.Path\('.qoder/agents'\).glob\('*.md'\)\):
    text = p.read_text\(\).split\('---'\)
    data = yaml.safe_load\(text[1]\)
    print\(f"{p.name}: name={data.get\('name'\)!r} tools={data.get\('tools'\)!r} disallowedTools={data.get\('disallowedTools'\)!r} permissionMode={data.get\('permissionMode'\)!r}"\)
PY)

Bash(python3 - <<'PY'
import yaml, pathlib, json
for name in \('lead','builder','reviewer'\):
    oc = yaml.safe_load\(pathlib.Path\(f'.opencode/agents/{name}.md'\).read_text\(\).split\('---'\)[1]\)
    qd = yaml.safe_load\(pathlib.Path\(f'.qoder/agents/{name}.md'\).read_text\(\).split\('---'\)[1]\)
    print\(f'== {name} =='\)
    print\('  opencode:', sorted\(oc\)\)
    print\('  qoder   :', sorted\(qd\)\)
print\('== .qoder/settings.json =='\)
print\(json.load\(open\('.qoder/settings.json'\)\)\)
PY)
